description: Driven notably by Rafale fighter jet sales to India and missile exports, France exported €21.2 billion worth of arms in 2025, matching its 2024 total.

description: Lev Shlosberg, one of the few Russian opposition figures to publicly denounce the offensive in Ukraine while remaining in Russia, has been sentenced to more than 11 years in prison. His party, the only anti-war political group, has been barred from the September 20 election.

headline: French PM asks ministers to clamp down on corruption in civil service
description: Sébastien Lecornu urged his government to step up its vigilance against integrity violations in public administrations and to intensify disciplinary action, amid rising drug trafficking and cybercrime.

headline: Meta's trial challenges the greed of tech platforms
description: Twenty-nine US states have taken legal action against Mark Zuckerberg's company, Meta. This trial signals a crucial societal wake-up call, reminiscent of the shift in public opinion against tobacco giants 30 years ago.

headline: Two years after Paris Olympics, Wembanyama returns as French national team captain
description: Victor Wembanyama will play his first game with France since the national team's loss to the US in the 2024 Olympics final on Thursday, facing Serbia. The San Antonio Spurs center is taking on new responsibilities in a significantly revised squad.

headline: Why are heatwaves becoming more frequent in France?
description: Between May and July, France was the most abnormally hot country in the world, compared to its average heat index. While the role of global warming is not under debate, the frequency of this summer's heatwaves is a topic of scientific debate.
